summary: Feature: Export and Download Video with Skeleton Overlay

details.user_story: As a User, I want to download the analyzed video with the green skeleton overlay burned in so that I can share it with my coach or post it to social media.
details.context: The overlay is currently rendered in real-time as an SVG. Exporting requires merging the video stream with the SVG coordinate layer into a single file.
acceptance_criteria: Add a 'Download Analysis' button to the results card and fullscreen view.
Merge VideoView content with SkeletonOverlay into a new MP4.
Save the resulting file to the device's Media Library or Files app.
Provide a native Share Sheet after successful export.
